Conditional actual10..14 chain: final check-only join design
==========================================================
This is a new theorem epoch. Mathematical conclusion, only after every edge
closes: under the retained analytic framework A, the stated published
Fourier/smoothing inputs F, and retained eventual-cutoff15 theorem T15,
the sharp conjectural iid Berry--Esseen constant is valid for every n>=10.
Unqualified cutoff10 is not asserted in this receipt because A and T15 are
retained dependencies rather than newly proved global reductions.

1. Same-law base at actual10
The global auxiliary bound C9<.423 holds for every standardized marginal.
For a hypothetical attained unrestricted positive closed sharp-contrary
maximizer at10, the direct contact inequality yields support<=3 on the low
moment range. The localized predecessor bound<.418 on rho[1.4,1.42]
supplies the upper part of that coarse support cover. Every predecessor
bound is all-threshold for the SAME marginal, not a selected CDF value.
For rho[1,1.1] and[1.1,1.15], the supported C9 bounds .4196 and .416 give
q=10*(cap-.4097)=.099 and .063. Direct contact then gives support2.3/2.4.
Only after this support acquisition do the own C10 caps .4188/.4152 and
the complete HIGH caps .345/.372 apply. The signed LOW callback requires
no physical gap, permitting a genuinely unseeded INITIAL raw=D=None.
Its first raw<2n/5 sign license precedes all physical D feedback.

Each of the nine full INITIAL covers accounts for10368 signed-moment cells
in the selected actual10 BN fine epoch and2592 in every other selected
index/band. Every cover retains all100 closed probability panels. Eight
ordered outward updates precede the final
export. The final D<sqrt10-1 and acquired positive physical endpoints license
the resource/count route; neither follows from the refuted moment-only D
seed. All100 original p panels in each of the two bands are accounted for
by a freshly replayed resource exclusion, a freshly accepted whole-panel
count forest, or a complete named finite union of closed p-subpanel forests.
Every forest retains all11 roots at10 and the original four non-p coordinate
intervals; the original p interval is covered wholly or by the union in §6. Criterion failures, domain failures, partial forests and
missing receipts leave the base open.

The separate supported corner Fourier theorem covers rho[1.15,1.42] for
support<=3; the universal high-rho theorem covers[1.42,infinity), including
the published infinite-rho tail. The boundaries1.1,1.15,1.4,1.42 belong to
both adjacent closed pieces. All reflected negative Kolmogorov branches
are covered by applying the unrestricted oriented witness reduction to
the whole reflected law, not by reflecting only sign probability p.

2. Sequential actual11..14
Assume the GLOBAL sharp theorem at n-1. Then every sharp-contrary attained
witness at n has q=0 in the contact inequality. The fixed refined support
is acquired before supported owncap/LOW/HIGH use. INITIAL/resources/counts
are evaluated at the literal n and all n+1 nearest-count roots. Each local
implication requires all200 original low-band panels and the same complete
Fourier complement. The join propagates only consecutively from the freshly
derived actual10 base. No monotonicity in n is used and no index is skipped.

3. Check-only acceptance contract
Every invocation reconstructs base10 directly from native selected receipts,
panel dispositions, exact outward resource interfaces, closed forest geometry,
and graph/capture bindings. It never reads a prior closure flag as evidence.
The same invocation reconstructs local11..14 implications before sequential
composition. Synthetic closure mutations prove that a missing base or failed
step cannot be bypassed. Thus the earlier historical flag-only base weakness
does not arise here.

The native full semantic resource, INITIAL, Fourier and leaf replays supply
the arithmetic. This join independently checks exact scopes, original panels,
source graphs, capture identity, all n+1-root geometry, strict stored scores,
outward interfaces and ordering. It makes no new count-oracle or quadrature
calls. Its shared interface/geometry helper is a source-bound range port of
the already independently derived prior checker, with explicit10..14 guards.

The retained T15 receipt is bound and its graph checked for stability; it is
not silently relabeled as freshly proved here. Its previously explicit
eventual20 historical dependency and unresolved recorded source paths remain
part of that retained qualification. A successful new numerical chain cannot
discharge unrelated compactness, contact, inversion or tail obligations A.

4. Exact execution and source identity
The v2 join requires the exact Python executable, command, working directory,
and final stdout status/scope/output digest for every INITIAL, coarse-support,
and resource construction and replay. All recorded metadata input digests are
bound to current immutable inputs; stable mandatory inputs include the replay
candidate and the resource preparation/source files. INITIAL construction
starts in an empty per-index output folder, so its logger can legitimately
record no local input files; its external engine is instead bound through the
complete PREPARED and candidate source graphs.

For every accepted count row, the n/band/panel, current FROZEN digest and
contract digest must agree. Both child captures must have their exact native
commands, capsule working directory and action identity. Their entire JSON
stdout must equal the selected construction/acceptance object. All24 math
modules must match the pinned template; the constructor and count checker
are reconstructed using an independently specified finite list of literal
substitutions. SOURCE_TRANSFORMS is checked against that list and cannot
authorize extra edits. This establishes source identity in addition to the
independent geometry/interface checks; native leaf arithmetic remains the
responsibility of the complete semantic replay.

In-memory controls corrupt commands, working directories, output digests,
stable input digests, count row identities, source-freeze hashes and source
transformations. Each corruption must reject. Receipt flag changes alone
cannot turn an incomplete base into a completed one.

5. Exact selected whole-family replacement in v3
This epoch selects the entire actual10 BN fine family:
 analytic/initial10_BN_fine_v1/n10,
 root/resource10_BN_fine_v1/BN,
 root/count10_BN_fine_v1/BN.
Every other actual index/band retains the original selected paths. The
selection is hard-coded, source-bound and recorded in the output inventory;
missing fine inputs never fall back to old BN evidence. Fine INITIAL has
grid[12,24,12,3],10368 cells/cover,26 scope mutations plus2 parser controls,
and its distinct native statuses/capture prefix. Independent fine-grid and
fine resource/count source reviews are additional mandatory premises.

The full fine BN resource inventory must point to those exact INITIAL result
and replay digests. Each original panel's source must equal that fine export
row, and every count contract/FROZEN/capture must point to the fine resource
row. No mixture of old and new row lineages is allowed. Shared conditional
resource/count status labels do not establish epoch identity: exact paths,
content digests and independently reconstructed native sources do.

All24 mathematical count modules, original d0<1/2 domain, sharp target,
10000-node/depth128 limits and all n+1 roots remain unchanged. The proposed
two-thirds inward extension and subpanel fallback are NOT inputs to v3.
Old baseline BN domain failures and bounded construction failures remain
preserved failed attempts. They supply no coverage to the selected fine BN
chain. The numerical obligations of the new whole family must finish afresh.

6. Current source status
This design is prepared for coordinating review. Do not execute it until its
sources and selected input paths are reviewed. A partial run writes only an
available-evidence snapshot with explicit pending edges. A final closure
requires the completed four Fourier readbacks, all selected INITIAL/support
replays, all resource replays and every necessary native count acceptance.
The preceding v1 is preserved and was never executed. Executed v2 is also
preserved; its partial snapshot correctly left the old BN failures open.
V3 is a distinct whole-family selection and awaits review before execution.

6. Named finite closed p-subpanel overrides in v4
The source-pinned override list selects a specific original n/band/panel.
Its acquired contract Q and resource/INITIAL provenance are unchanged. For
that original panel I=[L,U], choose rational L=t0<...<tm=U, with closed
components[tj,t(j+1)]. Each component retains all n+1 count roots and the
other four ORIGINAL coordinate intervals. Every witness in I belongs to
at least one component. The same Q applies there by universal restriction;
a complete forest for that component therefore excludes the witness or
bounds its score. Finite union proves the original panel, with both sides
of each seam included. No averaging or change of iid marginal is involved.

The v4 join first checks the unchanged original resource-to-count interface.
It reconstructs the original protocol from the pinned retained template,
then checks only explicitly derived subdomain/header changes to obtain each
new component protocol. No declared free-form source transform is executed.
Each component's original contract bytes,24 math modules, exact subdomain,
constructor/full-replay capture and stored geometry must agree. Root geometry
uses the component p interval and the original four remaining intervals.
All mathematical guards remain intact, including d0<1/2 and original Lambda.

Each forest independently retains nodes<=10000 and depth<=128. With m
components and L total leaves, the aggregate node identity is2L-m(n+1).
Aggregate statistics distinguish original panels from component forests.
One missing or failed component leaves the original panel pending; no partial
union, existing failed whole-panel attempt, or editable closure flag can
supply the missing coverage. All100 original panels per band remain the
coverage target. No discovery or numerical leaf oracle runs in this join.
